carry: Pre-study: the Lean flow pre-study, section K12.
Until this lands the orchestrator carries verdicts with app_approve.sh --carry (#1667).
brief: Make ruling R4 true in the tool (Lean flow study K12). update_pr.sh merges origin/main into the head unconditionally, in the step after it takes the handoff code head, and has no flag to skip it; app_push.sh has no body-only mode. So every body fix moves a clean head: observed 2026-10-21 on #2513, #2544, #2548, #2529 and #2549, each then carried by app_approve.sh --carry or re-reviewed. Change: (a) merge origin/main only when the pull request is DIRTY or git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD reports a conflict; (b) a body-only mode, taken when the code sha argument is the dash and the pull request head already contains the handoff tip: no worktree commit, no delivery-row commit when the row exists, the body contract (prepr's pr-body step and carry_audit.py check) run at the unchanged head, then app_push.sh's body PATCH with nothing pushed, and the script refuses if the head moved; (c) cloud_relay.sh's handoff arm, which today skips any topic whose code tip the head already contains and so never propagates a body-only move, calls the body-only mode when the handoff-body tip changed. pr-contract re-runs on the edited event, so the body is re-gated without a push. Controls: with main ahead and a clean merge-tree, the head sha is identical before and after; a DIRTY fixture still absorbs; a body-only run on a moved head refuses; the relay fixture calls body-only exactly once per body move; each rule has a mutant. Sequence with the open row-only change #2567 and #2560 (update_pr lock), which touch the same script.
